div.b:
GRADUATED SCORING STRATEGY:
NON-TECHNICAL: Like grading a test - perfect answers get full points, close answers get partial credit.
TECHNICAL: Percentage error thresholds create reward tiers. Prevents harsh binary scoring while maintaining accuracy incentive.
